subject: Kickoff: private instruction data for alignment (dp_instructions)
body:
Team,

Kicking off the privacy-preserving instruction pipeline. The recipe from our open-source release: DP fine-tune a 7B/13B model on real user instructions, sample synthetic instructions from it, then resample with a DP histogram so the synthetic distribution tracks the real one — all under a formal privacy guarantee. The product goal is an alignment data pipeline we can run on partner conversation logs without their instructions ever entering training directly.

Milestones: pipeline stood up end-to-end on the Chatbot Arena-style corpus by end of April, quality gate (instruction-following evals on the SFT'd model) by late May, privacy review sign-off and handoff by June 8.

Kofi's team should see the DP histogram accounting early — the resampling step is the novel bit for them.

Daniela owns staffing; note we'll need real infra help on the RLHF leg.

Dmitri
